items.title: ADM Shares Rise After Strong Earnings Beat and Higher Full-Year Outlook
items.summary: Archer Daniels Midland Co. (NYSE:ADM) shares gained more than 4% after the agricultural commodities group reported second-quarter 2026 results that comfortably exceeded profit expectations and raised its earnings outlook for the full year.

items.title: Archer-Daniels-Midland Again Raises Outlook on New U.S. Biofuels Policy
items.summary: Archer-Daniels-Midland once again raised its full-year adjusted earnings outlook, after the Trump administration earlier this year issued new rules requiring gas and diesel to contain more biofuels.

items.title: Archer-Daniels-Midland (NYSE:ADM) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Agricultural supply chain giant Archer-Daniels-Midland (NYSE:ADM) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 7.2% year on year to $22.68 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.84 per share was 28% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
